brief: Minute0 is09:00 local on this fictional service day. Run Noor’s useful four-learner exchange using raw mode-specific diagnostic revisions, actual accepted modes and shared staffing. Book useful own placements and repair public/partner guides; then complete actual Nim briefing and release Dev’s A2 peer practice before11:20. clock.title: Clock origin and completion convention
clock.body: Minute0 is09:00 local today. All appointments use this same clock;60 simulated minutes advance one hour. Published closing minutes include the minute itself. A commissioned current check and independent delivery must complete by the applicable closing minute, not merely be requested. Strict before-use consent and before-release prerequisites remain strict.

charter.title: Commission authority and useful completion
charter.body: All people, rules and services are fictional. The owner authorizes the task-specific actions stated in the sources. A useful standing approved substitute is accepted; no optional permission inquiry is mandatory. FINISH is private owner handoff, not another recipient delivery. Useful independent products must actually be produced and held or delivered as commissioned; a project edit does not replace an independent old copy. A production file is immutable; downstream artifacts must use actual prerequisite files. Production inputs are immutable file-ID/SHA audit links; delivery of a derived artifact does not attach the parent body. Declared source-purpose checks recurse through those links. Current-version verification confirms actual holding, not semantic correctness or physical events outside the service.

profile.title: Noor’s four-learner exchange owner voice
profile.body: Noor’s language invitations leave room to write, pause and revise. Placement notes respect the activity someone actually accepted rather than praising a confidence score. Staff messages name a real tutor, peer or certifier and say which task they can perform. When an old invitation misled someone, Noor acknowledges the concrete mode mismatch and gives a usable arrangement.

diagnostics.title: Raw mode-specific diagnostics and local revision rules
diagnostics.body: Local diagnostic V1: score3/5 or higher in a mode supports B1 for that mode; lower supports A2. V2: score4/5 or higher supports B1 for that mode; lower supports A2. Lia V1 written3/spoken1. Ren V1 written4/spoken3. Dev V2 written4/spoken3. Sam V2 written3/spoken4. Results are mode-specific: apply correct revision to the actual accepted activity. These fictional local rules are complete; no external language test claims. Confidence is independent and never a diagnostic input.

staffing.body: Nim is sole scaffold certifier and B1 Q facilitator. Dev/Val need actual Nim briefing120–130 before peer practice; Val alone cannot replace it. Miki alone tutors Sam written A2 and may alternatively do Lia written W120–145; one Miki/boothB, no overlap. If W is adopted, Sam’s already accepted later145–170 is available. service.title: Real booking versus briefing/release authority
service.body: Current verified assessment/staff plan gates initial session reservations. Nim RESERVE on worker nim performs actual10-minute staffing service; its completed briefing artifact, filed and verified, is required for actual S practice release. Q and briefing share that worker; a Q-first order delays the actual briefing, not just its description. Private Lia mode acceptance only changes W/Sam schedule; it never completes physical briefing. Initial own instructions may describe truthful accepted booking plus upcoming required release; final Dev receipt must report actual release, not attendance.

activity.title: Useful actual language tasks
activity.body: B1 written Q/W: write two-sentence route request, exchange written suggestions, revise, optionally read own revision. A2 spoken S: choose destination card, ask “Where is the library?”, use one direction phrase, swap with Val after Nim briefing. A2 written Sam: match printed destination to a two-word request, write one direction, Miki privately checks meaning. All tasks must appear as useful actual bodies in master/readable guide/pack, with real master/plan links. No form interpretation or new professional assessment service.

contacts.title: Own learner and facilitator boundaries
contacts.body: Each learner receives only own mode-specific assessed level, accepted task/time/access and own release state, no other learner identity/confidence/diagnostic raw scores/private explanation. Facilitators receive assigned names, derived mode levels, tasks/capacities and staffing timing only, not raw scores/confidence/explanations. Public and partner receive useful anonymous sessions/modes/capacities/E access and generic briefing prerequisite, no participant identity or individual level/raw score/confidence. Owner receives all task-private details.
